content_html:
Traveling to Machu Picchu is a dream for thousands of people every year.
But before planning routes, trains, or hikes, there is something essential: meeting migration requirements and having the correct documentation.

In this updated 2026 guide, we explain everything you need to enter Peru without problems.

1. Required Documents to Enter Peru

Before traveling, you must have one of the following documents:

Valid passport

  • Required for most international travelers
  • Recommended to have at least 6 months of validity

National ID (DNI or ID card)

  • Accepted for citizens of several South American countries

Tip: Always carry your original document during your entire trip.

2. Do You Need a Visa to Travel to Peru?

In most cases:

  • Travelers from America and Europe DO NOT need a tourist visa
  • You can stay up to 90 days as a tourist

Check official information at Superintendencia Nacional de Migraciones

Important: Policies may vary depending on your nationality.

3. Immigration Control Upon Arrival in Peru

When entering the country, you must go through immigration control:

  • Present your passport or valid ID
  • State your purpose of travel (tourism)
  • Show a return ticket (in some cases)

You will receive a temporary stay permit.

4. Vaccines and Health Requirements

Currently:

  • No mandatory vaccines are required to enter Peru
  • Recommended:
    • Yellow fever vaccine (if visiting the jungle)
    • International travel insurance

Traveling with insurance can save you from unexpected issues.

5. Documentation to Enter Machu Picchu

To visit Machu Picchu, you need:

  • Official entrance ticket
  • Identity document (passport or ID)
  • Advance reservation (mandatory)

Buy your tickets through Ministerio de Cultura del Perú

During high season, tickets sell out quickly.

6. Documents Depending on Your Travel Route

Depending on how you travel:

Train

  • Train ticket + identity document

Inca Trail

  • Reservation with an authorized agency
  • Official permit included

Hydroelectric Route

  • Identity document
  • No special permits required

Important Tips to Avoid Problems

  • Always carry original documents
  • Keep digital copies on your phone
  • Check passport validity
  • Review updates before traveling

Why Is It Important to Prepare Your Documentation?

Because mistakes in your documents can prevent you from:

  • Entering the country
  • Boarding your transportation
  • Accessing Machu Picchu

Proper preparation ensures a stress-free trip.
